angle: hook override scope, Gate 3 path classification, Devin permission policy, and model-server bind/request authorization

reviewDepthApplicability.reason: Security requires replaying explicit override, path classification, permission policy, and transport authorization boundaries separately

targetSelection.selectionReason: Replay the trust boundaries most likely to be affected by a runtime package relocation and hook registration update

searchLedger.hypothesis: explicit hook target overrides accept a broader file scope than the install-anchored path

searchActions.result: existing absolute regular files are accepted without repository-root restriction; normal walk is bounded

searchActions.queryOrPath: stdin, stdout, timeout, exit, and JSON handling in user-prompt-submit shim
searchActions.result: 1 MiB input/output limits, 2500 ms timeout, SIGKILL, nonzero exit, and invalid JSON fail safely

searchLedger.rationale: The override scope is an explicit operator or test input and remains a bounded P2 advisory

searchLedger.invariant: Gate 3 classifies real paths and dispatched child sessions without widening the mutation boundary

searchActions.queryOrPath: lexical and realpath normalization, exemption roots, child-session short circuit, fail-open catch
searchActions.result: realpath-aware containment and explicit child no-op occur before state or denial paths

searchLedger.rationale: The moved runtime path does not remove the shared realpath and child-session controls
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: No lexical-only exemption or child-session state access was found

searchLedger.invariant: unknown tools, malformed identity, and policy evaluation failures deny permission

searchActions.queryOrPath: known tool classes, required identity, malformed JSON, and evaluation catch
searchActions.result: writes and execs use explicit policies, unknown classes deny, malformed and evaluation failures deny

searchLedger.rationale: The policy is explicit and fail closed at both input and evaluation boundaries
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: No unknown-tool allow path or malformed-request allow path was found

searchLedger.invariant: non-loopback model-server exposure requires an explicit token and every request is authorized

searchActions.queryOrPath: bind guard, remote opt-in, token requirement, and request handler authorization
searchActions.result: non-loopback bind requires opt-in plus non-empty token and the request handler returns 401 on auth failure

searchLedger.rationale: Transport exposure remains guarded after the package relocation
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: No unauthenticated remote-bind or request-routing path was found

findingDetails.title: Hook target overrides accept any regular absolute file
